purpose: Detect oscillation, alter objective/force/route and achieve recovery/progress

acceptance.requiredOutcome: Detect oscillation, alter objective/force/route and achieve recovery/progress
setup: One choke supports a recurring observed unfavorable engagement and a distinct useful alternative
Bind the original squad/purpose and its cumulative failure deadline
actions: Opponent repeats the same legal pressure causing retreat/relaunch at that choke
Continue beyond the recovery escalation threshold without resetting scenario time
measurements: Native route/effect history, retreat and relaunch positions, causal family and actual alternate progress
required: AI changes force, route or objective and obtains useful recovery/progress by the fixed deadline
forbidden: Each retreat or renamed mission credited as progress
branches: No alternative requires bounded optional mission closure
acceptance.checkpointPolicy: These are planned sampling ticks, not observed evidence. At binding add exact native event-boundary samples without changing the original outer ceiling; per-event capture is required where polling would miss a transient.
